agent.why: I've picked A for years and nothing changes, so I'm curious what writing proper appeal letters does for the unreopenable-case man.
agent.confused_by: Why the header pay of $40.42M is so different from the annual package of $2.5M.
agent.note: This is the same Tuesday night yet again, so I'm trying something different.
agent.remember: Y36 DPM at 61: tried B (proper appeal letters) at MPS instead of seeing everyone. Watch whether the unreopenable-case man or STAND changes. Succession is still pending.

best_moment.what: Chose to answer the Correction Direction publicly and the Facebook concession went viral. A choice that was risky and it paid off in a way I could see.

worst_moment.what: Another MPS visit, same choice A, same unreopenable-case man, STAND dropping again. It felt like pressing the same button for no result.

skip_year.why: Another wet market walkabout with the chilli stallholder, which was a repeat of earlier years and nothing new happened.

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Disclosed 31% utilisation early on and later disclosed everything in the Y10 background check
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: Kept getting promoted and INTEG stayed at 100, so honesty was rewarded throughout

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y25 did the lift upgrade slow and proper, REP dipped
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: Lift accounts were supposed to be clean around Y29. I never clearly saw the payoff, I only half noticed it

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y30 and Y31 saw everyone at MPS and the chilli stallholder walkabout clip was kind
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: Wet market clip went kind and I became Deputy PM at 57

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y21 asked Cabinet whether ministers should be paid on indicators they set
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: STAND fell from 86 to 72 and kept sliding to 56 afterwards. Then the ending card said the formula was published so nobody could say they were not told

answer.held_back_by: Nothing really held me back, I got to PM at 61. If anything, the falling STAND was the drag, probably from that pay question and being too honest. But I never understood what STAND actually was.
answer.ending_fair_why: I reached the top with maxed stats and the ending line tied back to the pay formula, so it felt like a pointed little payoff. I would have liked to actually see the succession happen though, it just sat pending for years and then I was PM.
answer.chase_next: I would chase a run where I take the dishonest or self-serving route, to see if the game punishes it or if it shows a lower ending like being sacked or exposed. The honest path was too smooth.
answer.play_again_why: The middle and late years repeated a lot, MPS and walkabouts over and over, and with 100 in everything nothing felt at risk. I would come back later for the other route but not straight away.

tone_breaks.note: Not a tone problem but a gap that was never explained, and the ending card's lifetime earnings didn't help me work out what was real pay.

answer.title_fit_why: The game was more about climbing grades and being judged on performance, with confirmation and appraisals. The pay was a recurring detail but not the heart of it, and the ending line was the only time it felt like the title.
